meaning.en: Deeply worried; weighed down with anxiety.
meaning.zh: 形容心事重重，非常忧愁。

examples.zh: 孩子高烧不退，妈妈忧心忡忡。
examples.en: The child's fever won't go down, and his mother is worried sick.

examples.zh: 面对不断上涨的房价，许多年轻人忧心忡忡。
examples.en: Many young people are deeply anxious about ever-rising house prices.

story.en: A woman in the Book of Songs waits for her husband: "While I have not seen my lord, my heart is anxious and troubled" (未见君子，忧心忡忡).
story.zh: 《诗经·草虫》中，女子思念丈夫："未见君子，忧心忡忡。"

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial (忧心忡忡地说). 忡 is chōng. Neutral, a little literary.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语。"忡"读 chōng。略带书面色彩。

natural: Stand up a pole and you see its shadow

meaning.en: Instant results; an effect that shows immediately.
meaning.zh: 在阳光下竖起竹竿，立刻就能看到影子。比喻立刻见到成效。

examples.zh: 这种药效果立竿见影，吃完半小时就不疼了。
examples.en: This medicine works instantly — the pain was gone half an hour after taking it.

examples.zh: 改变学习习惯不会立竿见影，要慢慢来。
examples.en: Changing study habits won't bring instant results — give it time.

story.en: This early Daoist text says the right method brings results as surely as "stand up a pole and see its shadow, shout into a valley and hear the echo" (立竿见影，呼谷传响).
story.zh: 东汉魏伯阳的《周易参同契》说："立竿见影，呼谷传响。"比喻效果立刻显现。

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (立竿见影的效果). Often negated: 不会立竿见影.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，如"立竿见影的效果"。也常用否定"不会立竿见影"。

natural: Rushing for quick success and immediate gain

meaning.en: Eager for quick success and instant gain; short-sighted.
meaning.zh: 急于求成，贪图眼前的功效和利益。

examples.zh: 教育不能急功近利，要着眼于孩子的长远发展。
examples.en: Education can't be about quick wins; it has to focus on a child's long-term development.

examples.zh: 一些企业急功近利，忽视了产品质量。
examples.en: Some companies chase short-term profit at the expense of quality.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (急功近利的心态). Critical; common in commentary on business and education.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，如"急功近利的心态"。含贬义，多见于评论。

meaning.en: Deep-rooted; firmly entrenched and hard to change.
meaning.zh: 根扎得深，柄长得牢。比喻基础稳固，不容易动摇。

examples.zh: "重男轻女"的观念在一些地方依然根深蒂固。
examples.en: The preference for sons is still deeply ingrained in some places.

examples.zh: 这种坏习惯根深蒂固，很难改掉。
examples.en: This bad habit is so entrenched it's hard to break.

story.en: The Laozi speaks of the way to long life as "deep roots and a firm stem" (深根固柢). The modern order 根深蒂固 developed later.
story.zh: 《老子》说"是谓深根固柢，长生久视之道"，后演变为"根深蒂固"。

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Often about attitudes, traditions or prejudices; tends to be negative. Also 根深柢固.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多指观念、传统、偏见，偏贬义。也作"根深柢固"。

natural: Each gaining and both shining brighter

meaning.en: To complement each other; each bringing out the best in the other.
meaning.zh: 互相配合，双方的长处和作用更能显示出来。

equivalents: go together like bread and butter

examples.zh: 红墙和白雪相得益彰，景色非常美。
examples.en: The red walls and white snow set each other off beautifully.

examples.zh: 他们俩一个擅长技术，一个擅长管理，合作起来相得益彰。
examples.en: One is strong technically and the other in management, so they complement each other perfectly.

story.en: Wang Bao wrote that when a wise ruler gains worthy ministers, "each gains from the other and both become more illustrious" (相得益章; 章 = 彰).
story.zh: 王褒在《圣主得贤臣颂》中说，明君与贤臣"聚精会神，相得益章"（"章"同"彰"）。

usage.en: Predicate, often A 与 B 相得益彰. Formal; used of people, colours, food, design.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说"A与B相得益彰"。书面语，用于人、颜色、菜肴、设计等。

meaning.en: To break new ground; fresh and original in style.
meaning.zh: 另外开创新的局面或形式。

examples.zh: 这场别开生面的运动会让大家笑声不断。
examples.en: This unconventional sports day had everyone laughing nonstop.

examples.zh: 他的演讲方式别开生面，吸引了很多听众。
examples.en: His fresh approach to public speaking drew a big audience.

origin.source: 唐·杜甫《丹青引赠曹将军霸》

story.en: Du Fu praised the painter Cao Ba for restoring faded portraits of meritorious officials: "Under the general's brush they took on a new face" (将军下笔开生面).
story.zh: 杜甫称赞画家曹霸重画凌烟阁功臣像："凌烟功臣少颜色，将军下笔开生面。"

usage.en: Usually attributive (别开生面的活动/表演). Positive.
usage.zh: 多作定语，如"别开生面的活动"。含褒义。

meaning.en: Bizarre; beyond belief; something ordinary reasoning cannot account for.
meaning.zh: 不是根据常理所能想象的。形容言行离奇古怪。

examples.zh: 他的做法真是匪夷所思。
examples.en: What he did is simply beyond belief.

examples.zh: 这个案子有很多匪夷所思的细节。
examples.en: The case has many bizarre details.

story.en: The Book of Changes, in the Huan hexagram, says that a gathering like a hill "is not what ordinary people would think of" (匪夷所思; 匪 = 非, 夷 = ordinary).
story.zh: 《周易·涣卦》："涣有丘，匪夷所思。""匪"同"非"，"夷"指平常。

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. More formal and stronger than 不可思议; often about bizarre behaviour.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。比"不可思议"更书面，多指言行离奇。

literal: turn back on · road · and · gallop

meaning.en: To run counter to; to go in completely the opposite direction.
meaning.zh: 朝着相反的方向跑。比喻方向和目标完全相反。

examples.zh: 这种做法与我们的初衷背道而驰。
examples.en: This approach runs directly counter to our original intention.

examples.zh: 一边说要减肥，一边天天吃夜宵，简直是背道而驰。
examples.en: Saying you want to lose weight while eating late-night snacks every day is completely counterproductive.

origin.source: 唐·柳宗元《杨评事文集后序》

story.en: Liu Zongyuan wrote that writers who each explore only one corner "turn their backs on one another and gallop along the road" (相与背驰于道者), drifting further and further apart.
story.zh: 柳宗元说，那些只探求一个方面的作家"相与背驰于道者，其去弥远"。

usage.en: Predicate, usually A 与 B 背道而驰. Critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说"A与B背道而驰"。含贬义。

natural: Smooth sailing with a following wind

meaning.en: Plain sailing; everything going smoothly. Also a common good wish.
meaning.zh: 船挂满帆，一路顺风。比喻非常顺利，没有阻碍。常用作祝福语。

examples.zh: 祝你新的一年工作顺利，一帆风顺！
examples.en: Wishing you a smooth new year in every way!

examples.zh: 创业的路不可能一帆风顺。
examples.en: Starting a business is never plain sailing.

usage.en: Very common as a blessing (祝你一帆风顺) and in the negative (不可能一帆风顺). In speech 一 is said yì (before 1st-tone 帆).
usage.zh: 常用作祝福语，也常用否定"不可能一帆风顺"。口语中"一"在第一声"帆"前读 yì。

meaning.en: Dilapidated from years of neglect; in disrepair.
meaning.zh: 因时间长久而失去维修，多指建筑物破旧。

examples.zh: 这座古桥年久失修，已经禁止车辆通行。
examples.en: The old bridge has fallen into disrepair and is now closed to traffic.

examples.zh: 村里的老房子大多年久失修。
examples.en: Most of the old houses in the village are dilapidated.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Used of buildings, roads and facilities.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，用于建筑、道路、设施。

natural: So few there are hardly any

meaning.en: Very few; hardly any.
meaning.zh: 非常稀少，没有几个。

examples.zh: 下雨天，公园里的游客寥寥无几。
examples.en: On rainy days there are hardly any visitors in the park.

examples.zh: 能坚持到最后的选手寥寥无几。
examples.en: Only a handful of contestants made it to the end.

usage.en: Predicate. Used of people or things that can be counted.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于可数的人或物。

meaning.en: To come one after another in quick succession.
meaning.zh: 后面的人脚尖接着前面人的脚跟。形容人或事接连而来。

examples.zh: 开业以后，订单接踵而至。
examples.en: After opening, orders came in thick and fast.

examples.zh: 失业之后，各种麻烦接踵而至。
examples.en: After he lost his job, one problem followed another.

usage.en: Predicate. Neutral; used of visitors, events, problems or opportunities.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。中性，用于人、事件、问题、机会。

natural: Strength won't follow the heart's wishes

meaning.en: The spirit is willing but the strength is lacking; unable to do what one wants.
meaning.zh: 心里想做，可是力量达不到。

equivalents: the spirit is willing but the flesh is weak

examples.zh: 爷爷想帮忙搬家，可是年纪大了，力不从心。
examples.en: Grandpa wanted to help with the move, but at his age he wasn't up to it.

examples.zh: 同时管两个项目，我有点力不从心。
examples.en: Running two projects at once is a bit more than I can handle.

usage.en: Predicate. Often about age, illness or being overstretched; sympathetic, not critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多因年老、生病或事务过多，不含贬义。

meaning.en: To pour in thick and fast; to come in great numbers one after another.
meaning.zh: 纷纷到来，连续不断地来。

examples.zh: 节目播出后，观众的来信纷至沓来。
examples.en: After the programme aired, letters from viewers flooded in.

examples.zh: 夺冠以后，广告邀约纷至沓来。
examples.en: After winning the title, advertising offers poured in.

usage.en: Predicate. Formal; stronger sense of volume than 接踵而至. 沓 is tà.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，数量感比"接踵而至"更强。"沓"读 tà。

natural: No time even to lift a hand

meaning.en: Caught off guard; taken by surprise with no time to respond.
meaning.zh: 事出意外，来不及应付。

examples.zh: 这场暴雨来得太突然，让大家措手不及。
examples.en: The rainstorm came so suddenly that it caught everyone off guard.

examples.zh: 对手的突然进攻打了我们一个措手不及。
examples.en: The opponent's sudden attack caught us completely by surprise.

usage.en: Predicate or object; set phrase 打/杀了个措手不及 (catch someone off guard).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，常说"打了个措手不及"。

meaning.en: Burning with anxiety; extremely worried and impatient.
meaning.zh: 心里急得像着了火一样。形容非常着急。

equivalents: like a cat on hot bricks

examples.zh: 航班一再延误，赶着去面试的他心急如焚。
examples.en: With his flight delayed again and again, he was beside himself — he had an interview to get to.

examples.zh: 孩子走丢了，父母心急如焚。
examples.en: The child went missing, and the parents were frantic with worry.

usage.en: Predicate. Spoken and written; stronger than 着急.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。语气比"着急"强烈。

meaning.en: Lifelike; so vividly portrayed it seems alive.
meaning.zh: 形容艺术形象非常逼真，像活的一样。

equivalents: as if it could leap off the page

examples.zh: 这些泥人捏得栩栩如生。
examples.en: These clay figures are incredibly lifelike.

examples.zh: 作者把人物写得栩栩如生。
examples.en: The author brings the characters vividly to life.

story.en: Zhuangzi dreamed he was a butterfly, "fluttering about, a butterfly to the life" (栩栩然胡蝶也), and on waking did not know if he was Zhuangzi who had dreamed of a butterfly or a butterfly dreaming it was Zhuangzi.
story.zh: 庄子梦见自己变成蝴蝶，"栩栩然胡蝶也"，醒来后不知是庄周梦见了蝴蝶，还是蝴蝶梦见了庄周。

usage.en: Predicate or complement (画得栩栩如生). Used of paintings, sculptures, characters in writing.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，如"画得栩栩如生"。用于绘画、雕塑、文学人物。

meaning.en: Dazzled; bewildered by too many things to look at.
meaning.zh: 眼睛看见复杂纷繁的东西而感到迷乱。

examples.zh: 超市里的商品多得让人眼花缭乱。
examples.en: There's such a range of goods in the supermarket it makes your head spin.

examples.zh: 杂技演员的动作快得让人眼花缭乱。
examples.en: The acrobats move so fast it's dazzling.

story.en: In The Western Chamber, the scholar Zhang first sees Yingying and says her beauty leaves him "eyes dazzled and tongue-tied" (眼花撩乱口难言).
story.zh: 《西厢记》中张生初见莺莺，说"则著人眼花撩乱口难言"。

usage.en: Predicate or complement, often 让人眼花缭乱. Also written 眼花撩乱.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，常说"让人眼花缭乱"。也作"眼花撩乱"。

meaning.en: To give help exactly when it's most needed.
meaning.zh: 在下雪天给人送炭取暖。比喻在别人急需时给予帮助。

equivalents: a friend in need is a friend indeed
help in one's hour of need

examples.zh: 公司困难的时候，这笔贷款真是雪中送炭。
examples.en: When the company was struggling, this loan was a real lifeline.

examples.zh: 锦上添花容易，雪中送炭难。
examples.en: It's easy to add to someone's good fortune, hard to help them when they're down.

origin.source: 宋·范成大《大雪送炭与芥隐》

story.en: Fan Chengda sent charcoal to a friend during heavy snow, writing a poem with the line "It's not that in snow one must send charcoal" — playing on the idea of practical help at the right moment.
story.zh: 范成大大雪天送炭给朋友，作诗"不是雪中须送炭，聊装风景要诗来"。

usage.en: Predicate or object (真是雪中送炭). Often contrasted with 锦上添花.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语。常与"锦上添花"对比。

literal: gain · not · make up for · loss
natural: The gain doesn't make up for the loss

meaning.en: Not worth it; the losses outweigh the gains.
meaning.zh: 得到的抵不上失去的。

examples.zh: 为了省一点钱买质量差的东西，结果得不偿失。
examples.en: Buying poor-quality goods to save a little money ended up costing more than it saved.

examples.zh: 熬夜学习伤了身体，真是得不偿失。
examples.en: Staying up late to study damaged his health — it really wasn't worth it.

usage.en: Predicate. Very common in everyday reasoning and advice.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。日常议论中很常用。

meaning.en: Safe and sound; unharmed.
meaning.zh: 平安无事，没有受到损害。

examples.zh: 地震过后，全村人都安然无恙。
examples.en: After the earthquake, everyone in the village was safe and sound.

examples.zh: 手机从三楼掉下去，居然安然无恙。
examples.en: The phone fell from the third floor and was somehow completely undamaged.

story.en: When an envoy from Qi visited Queen Dowager Wei of Zhao, she first asked: "Is the harvest well? Are the people well? Is the king well?" (岁亦无恙耶？民亦无恙耶？王亦无恙耶？) — putting the people before the king. 无恙, "without harm", was an old greeting.
story.zh: 齐王派使者问候赵威后，赵威后先问"岁亦无恙耶？民亦无恙耶？王亦无恙耶？"把百姓放在君王之前。"无恙"是古时问候语。

usage.en: Predicate. Used of people or things after danger. 恙 is yàng.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于经历危险后。"恙"读 yàng。

natural: Going in deep, coming out simple

meaning.en: Explaining profound ideas in simple, accessible terms.
meaning.zh: 内容深刻，表达却浅显易懂。

examples.zh: 这位教授讲课深入浅出，学生都很喜欢。
examples.en: The professor explains difficult ideas simply, and the students love his lectures.

examples.zh: 这是一本深入浅出的科普书。
examples.en: This is a popular-science book that makes complex ideas easy to understand.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Praise for teaching, writing and explanations.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，称赞讲解或文章通俗易懂。

meaning.en: Unknown to the public; working quietly without fame.
meaning.zh: 不出声，没人知道。形容人没有名声，不为人知。

examples.zh: 很多科学家一辈子默默无闻地工作。
examples.en: Many scientists work their whole lives without recognition.

examples.zh: 她在小山村默默无闻地教了三十年书。
examples.en: She quietly taught in a small mountain village for thirty years.

usage.en: Adverbial (默默无闻地工作) — often admiring of quiet dedication — or predicate (obscure).
usage.zh: 多作状语，如"默默无闻地工作"，常含赞扬；也作谓语表示不出名。

natural: Following reason, the writing takes shape

meaning.en: Logical and natural; following as a matter of course.
meaning.zh: 写文章或做事合乎情理，自然而然。

examples.zh: 他俩相恋多年，结婚是顺理成章的事。
examples.en: They've been together for years, so getting married was the natural next step.

examples.zh: 成绩一直第一，他顺理成章地被选为班长。
examples.en: Always top of the class, he was naturally chosen as class monitor.

story.en: Zhu Xi said that good writing is simply "following reason so that it forms a composition" (文者，顺理而成章之谓也).
story.zh: 朱熹说："文者，顺理而成章之谓也。"

usage.en: Attributive (顺理成章的事), adverbial or predicate.
usage.zh: 多作定语、状语、谓语，如"顺理成章的事"。

natural: As if from the same wheel-rut

meaning.en: Exactly alike; cut from the same cloth.
meaning.zh: 好像出自同一车辙。比喻两件事情非常相似。

examples.zh: 这两起诈骗案的手法如出一辙。
examples.en: The two scams used exactly the same method.

examples.zh: 他们俩说话的口气如出一辙。
examples.en: The two of them talk in exactly the same way.

usage.en: Predicate. Often about methods, arguments or mistakes; slightly negative.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多指手法、说法、错误等，略带贬义。
